scope: Six reused independent public recordings (four music, two non-music) plus one private derived repeat. Interval/engraving regression, no annotated accuracy benchmark.
resource_scope: One sequential run per version/sample in a warm installed environment. Analysis wall time includes startup, transcription, notation, SVG and semantics, before independent checks. Memory is actual process lifetime peak working set recorded by semantic branch before final report serialization, not whole-system RAM or isolated notation/model allocation.

baseline_measurement: Retained 1.3.2 outputs and metrics from the same machine, exact source commit and identical audio hashes; candidate rerun now. Timing observations are not a controlled speed benchmark.

svg_geometry.method: SVG fill/stroke sampled at 0.3 CSS pixel grid, >=2 common points. Own note/chord stem joins and nearby tie endpoint owners excluded. Diagnostic proxy, not exhaustive collision certification.
svg_geometry.public_scope: Aggregate and per-page counts only; private collision symbol IDs and glyph coordinates omitted.

visual_review: First-page before/after images inspected for Brahms, Fishin and the private derived repeat; all pages measured geometrically. No complete page-by-page manual engraving audit.

isolated_notation_timing.method: One warmed process, three interleaved A/B rounds per input, build_score + MusicXML + SVG only. No transcription or semantic inference. Informal local timing, not cross-platform benchmark.
